classes.class_summary: Android UI automation flow class for managing HPX Shortcuts functionality including creating, editing, deleting shortcuts, and configuring print, email, and save destinations with various settings.

methods.docstring: Initialize HpxShortcuts flow with driver instance.
Create a new shortcut with specified name and optional settings.
Edit an existing shortcut with new settings.
Select a shortcut from the list.
Configure print destination settings including printer selection, copies, color, sides, paper size, etc.
Configure email destination settings including recipients, subject, message, file format, etc.
Configure save destination settings including location, file name, file format, etc.
Set scan settings including resolution, color mode, document type, etc.
Verify that a shortcut with the given name exists.
Retrieve details of a specific shortcut.
Navigate to the shortcuts screen from home.
Add a new destination of specified type (print, email, save).
Remove a destination of specified type.
Validate that shortcut settings match expected values.
